description:
*(FEQ327R229)*  

*Note: Open to hiring in Sweden, Denmark & Finland*



The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) team executes on Databricks' strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritised product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position *in-depth* the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.



The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.

  


**The Lakebase product-line requires the following core technical competencies:**


* 10+ years of transactional database (OLTP) expertise across engineering, product development, administration, and pre-sales, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing solutions.
* Credibility in influencing OLTP products with the market insight needed to shape and prioritise roadmap capabilities.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate transactional data systems within broader Big Data, Lakehouse, and AI ecosystems.
* Infrastructure, platform and administration expertise around disaster recovery, high availability, backup and recovery, scale-out methods, identity and security management, migrations (vendor-to-vendor, on-prem to cloud)


**The impact you will have**


* Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.
* As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.
* Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.
* Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams
* Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.


 **Competencies & Responsibilities**


* 6+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.
* Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.
* Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organisations to drive customer outcomes.
* Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python. Also requiring prior experience with Apache Spark or similar analytics engine tooling for large-scale data processing.
* Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, AI, ML, governance, transactional systems, app development, and streaming.
* Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.
* A track record of driving complex projects to completion in fast-paced, customer-facing environments.

title: ERP Application Specialist
description:
**About the Company**  

About Norden and Coesia Group Norden, part of Coesia since 2008, is the world's leading supplier of high-performance tube filling systems. Based in Kalmar, Sweden, where the first tube filling machine was built in 1934, Norden employs around 300 people in Kalmar and delivers 130–150 machines every year to more than 1,800 active customers in 60 countries. Coesia is a group of innovation-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Coesia's companies are leaders in automation solutions for multiple industries, ranging from automated processing and packaging machinery, testing and vision systems, to digital printing technologies, factory flow solutions and precision gears. Our customers include leading players in Consumer Goods, Healthcare & Pharma, Tobacco, Ceramic Tiles, Luxury Goods, Aerospace, Racing & Automotive, Electronics. Coesia has 82 production facilities in 34 countries, revenues of 2,121 million euros in 2025 and over 8,300 employees.  

**About the Role**  

About the Role The ERP Application Specialist, directly reporting to the local IT Manager, plays a pivotal role in maintaining and developing solutions for our ERP system in strong collaboration with the central Digital, Data & IT function guaranteeing the best support. The role involves close collaboration with users across the organization, helping to analyze business requirements, solve problems, and develop efficient system solutions. Together with a Norden IT colleague and in strong collaboration with the Central Digital, Data & IT Competence center, you will be responsible for the technical management of IFS Cloud in accordance with our application management model. You will work with technical analysis, configuration, integrations, and user support, while also driving improvement initiatives and contributing to projects related to system development. You will also work with integrations involving, among others, Microsoft Fabric and Novacura Connect. The Digital, Data & IT is a central function with 132 colleagues. The ERP Center of Excellence is based in Coesia HQ in Italy and collaborates closely with the Norden local IT department. The local IT consists of five colleagues with expertise in infrastructure, hardware, and business systems management. Key Responsibilities • Maintain, administer, configure and further develop IFS Cloud • Provide advanced support and user assistance to the business • Analyze, develop, and maintain databases, reports, and SQL queries while ensuring high data quality and a strong understanding of system and data relationships • Perform technical analyses and impact assessments • Develop and maintain integrations between different systems in collaboration with the Central Hyperautomation & Integration team • Plan and execute testing in connection with system changes and upgrades • Participate in and lead IT-related projects connected to the ERP platform • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities for development and process improvement ensuring the right demand management process  

**What You Need to Be Successful**  

Personal Qualities To succeed in this role, you are analytical, structured, and solution-oriented. You have a strong interest in ERP systems and process development and enjoy transforming business needs into effective system solutions. You are service-minded and communicative, with the ability to collaborate with users at different levels of the organization. You take ownership of your work, drive initiatives forward, and are committed to continuously improving processes, systems, and ways of working. While the right skills and experience are important, we also place great value on personal qualities. Therefore, significant consideration will be given to personal suitability.  

**Our Offer**  

We offer a varied and rewarding role in a technically advanced environment where you will have the opportunity to influence and contribute to the company's continued digital transformation. You will become part of an engaged IT team characterized by close collaboration, knowledge sharing, and short decision-making paths. As part of our organization, you will not only work closely with the local business in Kalmar but also be connected to the wider Coesia IT organization. This provides access to a broad international network of IT professionals, valuable knowledge-sharing opportunities, and collaboration across multiple companies and business units within the Group. The combination of local responsibility and global expertise offers an excellent environment for professional growth and continuous learning. At our Kalmar site, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact while benefiting from the resources, experience, and best practices of a global organization.  

**Join the Team!**  

Interested?Are you our next colleague? Submit your application through the link below today. We review applications on an ongoing basis, which means the position may be filled before the closing date. Application deadline: 2026-12-06 If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact: ICT Supervisor Jonas Lind jonas.lind@nordenmachinery.se or HR Jenny Nikolausson Tyni jenny.nikolaussontyni@nordenmachinery.se

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
**Shape the Future of Secure Connectivity in the largest insurance company in the Nordics**

Do you want to work hands‑on with Palo Alto firewalls and network security in a modern hybrid environment – and help shape how If connects securely to datacentres, cloud and the internet? We are looking for a Network Security Engineer with senior PaloAlto NGFW experience to strengthen our Connectivity Platform and take our firewall and edge security services to the next level.


**About the role**
------------------


As Network Security Engineer, you will work with our PaloAlto NGFW’s and security platform across datacentres, cloud hubs and local internet breakouts. Your main responsibility is to help design, implement and operate secure, robust and standardized network security services that support If’s business and our technology strategy.


In your daily work you will:


* Operate and develop our PaloAlto firewalls and related services – not just maintain existing rulebases, but actively improve how we design, structure and manage policies.
* Drive modernization of our Security Gateways, including adoption of new PaloAlto features and potentially new management solutions, in line with our future architecture.
* Work with automation and templates (APIs, scripting, IaC tools, etc.) to change how we handle policies and configurations – reducing manual work and the risk of human error.
* Design and refine security policies for data centers, internet breakouts and cloud hubs, with a clear focus on standardization and reuse.

Support projects and migrations with secure connectivity designs and implementation, ensuring new solutions fit our long‑term network security direction. You’ll work both in a team and independently and take responsibility from an idea all the way to a running service. There is room to influence how we work and to grow your skills in cloud, security and identity.


**We offer**
------------


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:


* An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as a highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits

**About the team**
------------------


The team’s mission is to modernize and operate our network security edge – moving from traditional, manual policy handling to standardized, automated and platform‑oriented services. You’ll work closely with the rest of the Connectivity Platform, as well as with IT Security, IT Engineering and our sourcing partners, in a collaborative and hands‑on environment. The team consists of 7 SME’s based in Copenhagen, Denmark, Turku, Finland and Espoo, Finland.

  

**Who are you?**
----------------


You are self-driven and take responsibility. When you see something that needs fixing, you pick it up and follow it through. You like to work with others, explain things in a clear way, and care about doing a good job. You are curious and keep learning new things.


**You also have:**
------------------


* Senior-level experience with PaloAlto NGFW
* Senior-level experience network fundamentals
* Senior-level experience designing or operating network security policies in Datacenter and/or cloud environments.
* Experience and interest in automation and standardization of firewall policies and configurations.
* Awareness of modern threats and security concepts (IPS/IDS, URL filtering, threat prevention, zero trust) and how they influence network design.
* Experience troubleshooting complex network/security issues and working in a structured way during incidents.
* Good command of Danish or Finnish and English

It is an advantage if you also have:


* Experience of working in an enterprise environment
* Experience of working with Panorama and/or Strata
* Experience in Cloud(AWS or Azure)
* Experience with Splunk
* Experience with ServiceNow
* Experience with GitHub Enterprise
* Experience of ADO

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------


**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 20.11.2026


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the application form.


**Work location:** Copenhagen, Denmark, Turku or Espoo, Finland.


**Travelling:** Some travelling will be expected


**Start:** 1st of February, 2027


For more information, please contact Frederik Arntzen, Head of Connectivity, frederik.arntzen@if.no


*It is a requirement for the position that If’s extended fit & proper requirements, including background checks, can be met.*

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
##### **About the role**


Quinyx is looking for a senior Security Architect to own security day to day across our product, our cloud platform and our information security management system (ISMS). You set the security requirements, review what Engineering and Platform build, run our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 programmes and follow findings through to closure. You report to the CIO and work with Engineering, Platform, SRE, IT and Legal. Security at Quinyx owns assessment, requirements, validation and follow-through.

  

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that bridges cloud security engineering and continuous assurance. You work directly in cloud environments, containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines and identity architecture, and you own the ISMS that proves the controls work.

##### **What you’ll do**

* **Cloud and architecture security.** Run security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product and infrastructure changes. Assess our AWS and GCP environments across IAM, networking, storage, databases, secrets and logging. Set the requirements and validate what Platform and SRE build.
* **SDLC and application security.** Embed security into CI/CD: IaC scanning, SAST, DAST, SCA and secret scanning. Review web and API security against OWASP ASVS and the Top 10, including authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC).
* **AI security.** Threat-model and review AI features, LLM integrations, agents and connectors in our product and internal tooling against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the OWASP AI Exchange. Maintain the security requirements in our AI Building Policy and check that builders follow them, covering prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, model and tool supply chain, and access to customer data.
* **Vulnerability management.** Own the process end to end across applications, cloud infrastructure and endpoints. Prioritise by attack path and asset context, and track pentest findings and risk exceptions through to verified closure.
* **Detection and incident response.** Define the security telemetry we collect, tune SIEM detections against MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and lead incident triage, containment and post-incident reviews.
* **ISMS and audits.** Run the ISMS for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 day to day. Keep policies, the Statement of Applicability and the risk register current. Coordinate internal and external audits, collect evidence and automate control monitoring in our GRC platform.
* **Vendor and customer assurance.** Assess third-party risk before we onboard a vendor and at renewal. Answer customer security questionnaires and assurance reviews with accurate, reusable evidence and keep our Trust Centre current.

##### **What we’re looking for**

* Several years of hands-on security work in a multi-tenant SaaS company, covering cloud security engineering and GRC.
* Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and working knowledge of the other: IAM, networking, workload security, KMS and audit logging.
* Securing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and containers, with practical use of SAST, DAST, SCA and secret scanning tools.
* Web and API security: OWASP ASVS and Top 10, and authentication and authorisation protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC).
* AI and LLM security: the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the OWASP AI Exchange, and practical experience with the risks of LLM integrations, agents and connectors (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, supply chain).
* Detection engineering: writing and tuning SIEM detections with MITRE ATT&CK as the reference.
* Operating ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II controls: evidence collection, auditor coordination and a formal risk register.
* Reads code and Terraform, writes automation in Python, Bash or PowerShell, and analyses telemetry with SIEM queries or SQL.
* Has led incidents and written the post-incident review.
* Turns a security finding into an action an engineer will take, and a risk into a sentence a leadership team will act on.

 **Nice to have (but not required)**

* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC, AWS Certified Security - Specialty or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with a GRC platform such as Vanta or Drata.
* Experience with GDPR from the data processor side.
* Experience applying the EU AI Act to a SaaS product.

 **Desired personality traits**

* **Pragmatic risk judgement.** You judge risk by material exposure and real exploitability, and you can explain why a critical tool score is a medium for us.
* **Ownership.** You follow findings and risk exceptions through to verified closure.
* **Clear communication.** You translate security concepts into practical actions for engineers, product teams and senior leadership.

##### **Why Quinyx?**


Quinyx is a leading workforce management platform, helping businesses simplify scheduling, optimize staffing, and engage their frontline teams. We empower organizations across the globe, ranging from retail and hospitality to logistics and healthcare, with smart, mobile-first solutions. Here, you’ll find:

* A truly international team with colleagues from all over the world
* A flexible and hybrid-friendly work culture
* Opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make a real impact
* An open, inclusive, and fun environment where your ideas matter

##### **What we offer**

* Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup with at least 2 days per week from the office.
* Enhanced vacation allowance, gym membership contribution, health insurance, and a pension plan.
* On-market pay.

##### **How to apply & Our process**


Ready to join the team? Submit your application below, and we’ll be in touch as soon as possible. What our hiring process looks like:

* Fill out a short application.
* Complete our psychometric and objective assessments through Alva Labs.
* Screening call with our Talent team.
* Meet the hiring manager (Deep Dive).
* Complete a role-specific technical case.
* Final interview (in-office).
* Offer, references & background checks.

##### **Quinyx is an equal opportunity employer**


We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees - no matter your background, identity, or experience.

##### **When work just works!**
